segments.title: Hype Train Surge Opening
segments.notes: Twitch hype train activates during pre-show; Case declines full graphics but allows the train to serve as intro sequence.

segments.title: Def Jam: Fight for New York Championship Bout
segments.notes: Case and co-host Fiona play through story mode as custom fighter 'K-Period', unlocking roster characters and defeating boss Trick after 20 attempts; commentary personas Chance the Rapper and Kid Rock provide post-fight rhymes.

segments.title: Fallout 4: Glowing Sea Expedition
segments.notes: Case switches to Fallout 4, explores the Glowing Sea, clears Finch Farm raiders, investigates Vault 88, and murders Vault-Tec personnel while Kendelle joins mid-stream for skincare discourse and privacy talk.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors extended gaming broadcast, pilots Def Jam and Fallout 4 gameplay while managing chat interaction and co-host dynamics.

characters.name: Fiona
characters.notes: Co-hosts gaming session, assists with Def Jam controls research and Fallout navigation, departs before Fallout midpoint.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Arrives mid-Fallout segment, discusses personal privacy boundaries and details Case's Korean skincare regimen on air.

lore_notes.fact: Case owns a functional PS2 and plays original discs legally on stream [01:00:00]
Case created custom Def Jam fighter 'K-Period' (Cape Period) with martial arts style and tribal tattoo of Jesus carrying cross [00:28:00, 00:44:22]
Kendelle maintains strict separation between her workplace and the broadcast, refuses Twitter cross-posting [03:03:22]
Kendelle implemented a multi-step Korean skincare routine for Case including La Roche-Posay cleanser, Dr. Jart serum, caffeine eye cream, and Korean sunscreen [03:35:19]
Case planned pirate costume for 'Unfair' event but missed order window [03:27:34]
Broadcast concludes with raid to Abelie at AT&T (Ovelie) [03:45:41]

episode_summary: Case Blackwell helms a marathon gaming broadcast opening with a hype train surge before diving into Def Jam: Fight for New York, where he and co-host Fiona craft a custom combatant and overcome the brutal boss Trick after two dozen attempts. The stream transitions to Fallout 4 for a Glowing Sea excursion featuring raider clearance at Finch Farm, Vault 88 infiltration, and indiscriminate Vault-Tec slaughter, interrupted by Kendelle's arrival for an extended on-air skincare consultation and workplace privacy discussion. The broadcast closes with a raid handoff to fellow streamer Abelie.
